items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was the bass player of record on there... Gene Kruppa was in the band.

ctx.x: Did the success of -- speaking of Goodman, did his success in the mid-thirties, did that have an effect on Grand Terrace business? Did it have an effect on what you guys played, or anything, that popularity? Of course there'd been that music played all along.
